queries.pinot: SELECT providerId, serviceType, COUNT(*) AS callCount FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY providerId, serviceType ORDER BY providerId, serviceType
queries.druid: SELECT providerId, serviceType, COUNT(*) AS callCount FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY providerId, serviceType ORDER BY providerId, serviceType

queries.pinot: SELECT providerId, PERCENTILETDIGEST(durationSeconds, 50) AS p50, PERCENTILETDIGEST(durationSeconds, 95) AS p95 FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY providerId ORDER BY providerId
queries.druid: SELECT providerId, APPROX_QUANTILE_DS(durationSeconds, 0.50) AS p50, APPROX_QUANTILE_DS(durationSeconds, 0.95) AS p95 FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY providerId ORDER BY providerId

queries.pinot: SELECT serviceType, DATETIMECONVERT(eventTime, '1:MILLISECONDS:EPOCH', '1:HOURS:EPOCH', '1:HOURS') AS eventHour, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(durationSeconds) AS totalDuration FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY serviceType, eventHour ORDER BY eventHour, serviceType LIMIT 5000
queries.druid: SELECT serviceType, TIME_FLOOR(__time, 'PT1H') AS eventHour, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(durationSeconds) AS totalDuration FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY serviceType, TIME_FLOOR(__time, 'PT1H') ORDER BY eventHour, serviceType LIMIT 5000

queries.pinot: SELECT providerId, outcome, COUNT(*) AS callCount FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY providerId, outcome ORDER BY providerId, outcome
queries.druid: SELECT providerId, outcome, COUNT(*) AS callCount FROM cdr_analytics_v1 GROUP BY providerId, outcome ORDER BY providerId, outcome

queries.pinot: SELECT eventId, callId, providerId, serviceType, direction, durationSeconds, outcome, sourceObservationCount FROM cdr_analytics_v1 WHERE callId = 'olap-call-00010000' LIMIT 1
queries.druid: SELECT eventId, callId, providerId, serviceType, direction, durationSeconds, outcome, sourceObservationCount FROM cdr_analytics_v1 WHERE callId = 'olap-call-00010000' LIMIT 1
